name: Survive In Area 51 Remake
desc:
🔴 It's simple. Your mission is to survive in area 51! 
🔴 Kill monsters, get cells, and unlock new weapons at shop! 
🔴 Find stronger weapons hidden in the map, portals or from a boss!
🔴 Press Shift key to Run! 
🔴 Most hidden items cost 2500+ cells, so consider killing enemies first!
🔴 This is a remake of SIA51! NOT a copy! We strongly respect PenguinDoc's work!
🔴 Exploiting in public servers will lead to a permanent ban.
